sources.note: CECIPU programme's own 'Becas de estudio' page (record's official_source_url). Read in full: general conditions, benefits, application requirements, application deadline, selection and mandatory documents for the 2026 cycle.

CECIPU programme home page on the same .gob.cl domain; footer reads 'CECIPU (c) Programa de Cooperación Internacional del Gobierno de Chile Para Policías Uniformadas Extranjeras 2026'. Confirms live programme and links to the 2027 prospectus and invitation letter.

Official application information sheet for the 2027 intake, published by the programme. Contact addresses are ssp-cecipu@minsegpublica.gob.cl and cmunozv@minsegpublica.gob.cl, i.e. Chile's Ministry of Public Security, corroborating the awarding body.

Programme's 'Cursos Ofrecidos' page listing the courses actually offered, grouped into Formación, Perfeccionamiento and Especialidades modalities at Carabineros de Chile and the Policía de Investigaciones de Chile. Confirms the award is for police training courses rather than academic degrees.

DIGEMPOL (División de Gestión y Modernización de las Policías) page of Chile's Ministry of the Interior describing the programme's history, creation by Decree No. 600 of 18 October 1995, and the interministerial executive commission that administers it. Read as corroboration only; its deadline text still shows the 2022 cycle, so it was not used for the deadline.

awarding_body.detail: The page is the programme's own site on the Chilean government domain cecipu.gob.cl, run by the CECIPU Executive Secretariat. The programme's official application information sheet carries the contact addresses ssp-cecipu@minsegpublica.gob.cl and cmunozv@minsegpublica.gob.cl (Chile's Ministry of Public Security), which matches the record's awarding body. DIGEMPOL (Ministry of the Interior) describes CECIPU as administered by an interministerial executive commission and links back to cecipu.gob.cl as the programme site.
awarding_body.quote: La Secretaría Ejecutiva del Programa CECIPU, comunicará por los medios oficiales al Director o Comandante General de la Institución Policial, la selección de él o los Policías postulantes a las Becas del Programa, reservándose el derecho de aceptar o rechazar las solicitudes recibidas conforme a la disponibilidad de cupos

deadline.detail: The page states the 2026 application period opens 1 August 2026 and closes 30 October 2026 at 23:59 hours. Today is 12 October 2026, so the cycle is currently open. The exact date matches the record's 2026-10-30.
deadline.quote: El plazo de postulación se inicia el 1º de agosto y cierra el 30 de octubre del 2026, a las 23:59 horas.

eligibility.detail: All distinct eligibility claims confirmed: the programme is aimed at officers, non-commissioned officers and enlisted personnel (Oficiales, Suboficiales o Tropa) of the uniformed police forces of countries joining the programme; applicants from civil police institutions are not accepted; non-Spanish speakers must have a medium/medium-high command of Spanish; and an official passport and life insurance are listed as obligatory documents.
eligibility.quote: Las Becas están dirigidas a Oficiales, Suboficiales o Tropa de las Policías Uniformadas de los países interesados en incorporarse al Programa. No se aceptarán postulantes de instituciones policiales civiles. Los postulantes no hispanoparlantes, deberán poseer un dominio medio/medio alto del idioma castellano.

funding.detail: Partially funded, as recorded. Each scholarship subsidises accommodation and food (external or boarding), primary medical and dental cover limited to circumstances arising from the course's own activities, and clothing and equipment for formation courses only. The page lists no airfare, no tuition or enrolment payment, and no stipend, so 'Fully Funded' would not be supportable.
funding.quote: Cada Beca otorga subvención para los siguientes ítems: - Gastos de arriendo y alimentación (externado) - Gastos de alojamiento y alimentación (internado) - Cobertura médica y dental primaria (sólo ante circunstancias derivadas de actividades propias del curso). - Vestuario y equipo necesario (solo cursos de formación).

degree_levels.detail: 'Other' is the right classification: the award funds police training courses of Formación, Perfeccionamiento and Especialización Policial at the teaching institutions of Carabineros de Chile and the Policía de Investigaciones de Chile, not academic Bachelor's/Master's/PhD degrees. The courses run 2 to 8 semesters.
degree_levels.quote: Las Becas ofrecidas por el Programa de Cooperación Internacional del Gobierno de Chile para Policías Uniformadas Extranjeras CECIPU, se otorgan para realizar estudios de Formación, Perfeccionamiento y Especialización Policial, en planteles docentes de las Fuerzas de Orden y Seguridad de Chile (Carabineros de Chile y de la Policía de Investigaciones de Chile), conforme al ofrecimiento que se hace anualmente.

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: El plazo de postulación se inicia el 1º de agosto y cierra el 30 de octubre del 2026, a las 23:59 horas. (Application period opens 1 August and closes 30 October 2026 at 23:59 hours.)
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Cycle window is fixed each year: opens 1 August, closes 30 October at 23:59. Re-check after 31 October 2026; the page normally rolls over to the next year's dates around then, and the 2027 intake prospectus and invitation letter are already posted on the site. Two caveats for the next check: the DIGEMPOL page (digempol.interior.gob.cl/cecipu) still shows the 2022 deadline and an old results month (November), so the cecipu.gob.cl 'Becas de estudio' page must be the source of truth for the deadline; and the funding list on the main page is slightly wider than the older DIGEMPOL version, which also mentions práctica policial, vestuario deportivo and vaccination validation, so benefit wording should be re-read at each re-check.

notes_for_reviewer: Nothing for a human to decide: all five claims were confirmed against the programme's own pages read on 12 October 2026 and the cycle is open. One point worth noting when reading the card: the award covers in-country living costs only, not international airfare, so applicants should not be told the scholarship pays for travel. Applications are submitted through the applicant's own police institution (authorisation letter and invitation letter are published on the site), not by the individual to the programme directly.
